functions.description: party proximity notices and field monster grounding
functions.lever: moved both 0219b33c message buffers into small static inline helpers (PostFound, PostNotice with nested InitNotice) so their stack slots fall below the loop-scoped Vector3i copy; PostNotice inlines only once its body is split to about 4 statements
functions.notes: Plain compound bitfield ops (nearMask |= 1 << id; &= ~(1 << id)) fixed the 4-bit field reload; explicit (unsigned char) casts CSE'd the load. Stack order: in-place locals slot in textual order (first = highest); locals inside inlined helpers sit below them. A 5-statement-plus-declaration inline helper with parameters was not inlined (emitted out of line). 18 gate runs.
